Mâm cúng nhập trạch là mâm cúng về nhà m.en: The feast was a new house offering prepared by all families to enter the new home. If the householders had better economic conditions, many offerings could be provided, if you were still struggling economically, the basics would be all you need. Usually a plate of tributes to Magdeburg would include offerings of fruit and salt offerings.
Mâm cúng nhập trạch là mâm cúng về nhà m.zh: 宴会是一家人准备进入新家的新房子。 如果住户的经济条件更好,可以提供许多供货,如果你仍然在经济上挣扎,那么基本需要的就够了。 通常一盘对马格德堡的贡品将包括提供水果和盐的祭品.

Nghi lễ cũng thể hiện sự bày tỏ, biết ơn.en: The ceremony also exhibits an expression of appreciation, the family's devotion to the god of the land that is in charge of the new area.
Nghi lễ cũng thể hiện sự bày tỏ, biết ơn.zh: 仪式上还展现出一种欣赏,家族对掌管新地区的土地之神的奉献.

Nghi lễ khi dọn về nhà mới như thế nào?.en: What was it like to move back home?

Ngoài ra nghi lễ này cũng thể hiện tinh.en: In addition, the ceremony displayed a positive, loving spirit, believing in future good things that the family would receive from the gods.

Sau khi khấn thổ thần xong, gia chủ làm.en: After praying to the gods, the master of the house began making an announcement and began packing the household, when he had finished packing the furniture, offering sacred offerings, the ancestors.
Sau khi khấn thổ thần xong, gia chủ làm.zh: 在向众神祷告后,屋主开始发表公告,开始收拾家用,当时他完成了家具的包装,提供了圣祭,祖先.

Sau đó sắp lễ vật lên mâm theo sắp xếp c.en: Then lay the gift on the platter in accordance with the priest's arrangement that is consistent with the host. The host is well dressed, neat, and clean to light the incense, plugging in the prayer reading to ask the spirits to take him to his new place and worship.
Sau đó sắp lễ vật lên mâm theo sắp xếp c.zh: 然后按照与主人一致的神父安排将礼物放在盘子上. 主持人衣着整洁,清净能点燃香,插上祷告诵经,请灵灵将他带到他的新处所和崇拜.

Theo quan niệm dân gian việc vận chuyển.en: According to the notion of the folk's transportation of houses should be done before 15 hours in the day, because if transport at night would bring in the host some bad air.
Theo quan niệm dân gian việc vận chuyển.zh: 根据民间运输房屋的观念,白天15小时前就应该完成,因为如果夜间运输会给宿主带来一些恶劣的空气.

Theo truyền thống tâm linh của người Việ.en: According to the Vietnamese spiritual tradition, when the householders moved to their new home, the host often organized the cult. What, then, is the significance of the ceremony?
Theo truyền thống tâm linh của người Việ.zh: 根据越南精神传统,当户口迁至新家时,宿主经常组织邪教. 那么,仪式的意义是什么?

Thực tế nghi lễ cúng về nhà mới thường đ.en: The fact that the ceremony of the new home is often referred to as the diocese inclusion, which is intended to inform the dialects, the spirits governing the new area of family presence for the time being. So that the spirits, in turn, help the host to live, work in that area. This was thus regarded as a ritual to obtain permission and announce to these mystics.
Thực tế nghi lễ cúng về nhà mới thường đ.zh: 新家园的仪式常被称作教区包容,意在为方言,家族存在的新领域暂时的支配灵体提供信息. 因此,精神,反过来, 帮助东道主生活, 在那里工作。 因此,这被视为获得许可并向这些神秘人物宣布的一种仪式。

Tiếp theo đó, gia chủ châm bếp lửa và nấ.en: Then, the master lit the fire and boiled the water for the kitchen as well as the tea offered to the gods, the fairies enjoyed it.
Tiếp theo đó, gia chủ châm bếp lửa và nấ.zh: 后来,师傅点燃了火,煮了厨房的水和献给众神的茶,仙女们享受了.

Trong nghi lễ cúng gia chủ sẽ chuẩn bị m.en: In the house ceremony the host will prepare a script to send prayers to the gods that will help the family to always be blessed, at peace, in happiness, in careers.
Trong nghi lễ cúng gia chủ sẽ chuẩn bị m.zh: 在殿堂仪式上,主持人会准备一个剧本,向众神发出祷告,帮助家族永远得到祝福,平和,幸福,事业.
